$comment: Words the validator refuses in the prose, grouped by why; each message says what to write instead. A trailing * also refuses every form of the word (leverag* = leverage, leveraged, leveraging…). The digest prints these lists as they are. Code names are exempt: they are checked against the change.

refused.why: future or modal; say what the code does now, in the present
a judgement; say the effect instead
a number in words; write digits
